fields.description: Whether grouped Sales/Purchase Invoice and Journal Entry (with Item Tax Template) Umsatz uses net or gross amounts. Match your Steuerberater BU-Schlüssel configuration. Per-company setting.
fields.label: Amount Basis

fields.description: Will be used as against account for all normal ledger entries
fields.label: Temporary Against Account Number

fields.description: Will be used as against account for opening ledger entries
fields.label: Opening Against Account Number

fields.description: DATEV BU-Schlüssel for incoming payments (Payment Entry type Receive)
fields.label: Receive BU-Schlüssel

fields.description: DATEV BU-Schlüssel for outgoing payments (Payment Entry type Pay)
fields.label: Pay BU-Schlüssel

fields.description: How Payment Entries appear in the Buchungsstapel. Agree both options with your Steuerberater before the first export.
fields.label: Payment Lines

fields.description: For a payment that settles several invoices or credit notes. per_invoice: one line per invoice / credit note with its allocated amount; credit notes get the opposite S/H, and the lines add up to the bank amount. per_payment: one line with the net bank amount. Payments settling a single invoice always export as one line.
fields.label: Lines per Payment

fields.description: Document number in Belegfeld 1 of a payment line that belongs to one invoice. payment_entry: the Payment Entry number. invoice: the invoice / credit note number, so DATEV can match the payment to its open item (OPOS). The Payment Entry number stays in Beleginfo - Inhalt 1 either way. Lines without a single invoice (per_payment with several invoices, unallocated amounts) keep the Payment Entry number.
fields.label: Belegfeld 1 on Payment Lines

fields.description: Export cancelled vouchers as their original rows plus a Storno on the same date (GitLab #106). Meant for clean-up runs, e.g. an invoice that was cancelled and amended instead of credited. Drafts are never exported.
fields.label: Include Cancelled Vouchers

fields.description: How Storno rows are written. generalumkehr: same Soll/Haben as the original, Generalumkehr (GU) = 1. swap_soll_haben: Soll/Haben swapped, GU empty. Agree with the Steuerberater.
fields.label: Storno Rows

fields.description: Which Customer/Supplier field holds the Steuernummer and which the USt-IdNr (GitLab #114). Custom fields work too; the field must exist on both Customer and Supplier. Same field for both: a value starting with two letters (DE123…) is sent as USt-IdNr, any other as Steuernummer.
fields.label: Master Data (Debitoren/Kreditoren)

fields.description: Sent as DATEV Steuernummer. Empty: no Steuernummer.
fields.label: Steuernummer from Field

fields.description: Disabled Customers/Suppliers that have bookings in the exported period. export: as any other party. export_inactive: DATEV Status = 1 (inaktiv); active parties keep their status in DATEV. leave_out: not in the Debitoren/Kreditoren file, listed under Master Data Warnings of the export.
fields.label: Disabled Customers/Suppliers

fields.description: Sent as DATEV EU-Land + EU-USt-IdNr. (country prefix split off). Empty: no USt-IdNr.
fields.label: USt-IdNr from Field
